name: Uber

SWE II (L4).dsaDepth: Heavy — LeetCode-style coding (DP, trees, binary search, strings) with follow-ups
rounds: Online assessment or live coding screen (CodeSignal reported)
Virtual loop of about 4 rounds: coding, low-level / machine coding, architecture, behavioral
extraTopics: Machine coding / low-level design (key-value store style problems)
SWE II (L4).notes: Round mix varies by team; one L4 report describes an assessment, two technical interviews and a hiring-manager round.

Senior SWE (L5A).dsaDepth: Heavy — hard algorithms plus production-quality machine coding
rounds: Business phone screen: 1 medium-hard/hard coding problem
Algorithms & data structures round (2 problems, e.g. tree + graph/topological sort)
Depth-in-specialisation round: machine coding of a small service
System design round (Uber-style: dispatch, surge pricing)

Staff SWE (L5B).dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — two coding rounds remain, design and project depth grow
rounds: Recruiter call and initial coding screen
Five-round final: two coding, one system design, one past-project round (behavioral deep-dive), and a further round
extraTopics: Deep dive on a past project and its trade-offs
